predictions.quote: I do think Ukraine is on track to become potentially the next Vietnam or the next Iraq.
predictions.prediction: Vivek Ramaswamy predicts that the Ukraine conflict will evolve into a protracted, Vietnam- or Iraq-style quagmire for the United States and its allies, rather than resolving quickly or cleanly.

predictions.quote: I believe we can achieve semiconductor independence.
predictions.prediction: Vivek Ramaswamy predicts that the United States will be able to achieve "semiconductor independence" (i.e., no longer being strategically dependent on foreign—especially Taiwanese—semiconductor manufacturing for its modern way of life) within a foreseeable future timeframe relevant to planning Taiwan defense policy.

predictions.quote: This is why I'm in this race. This is actually why at this point, I couldn't have told you this in March. But at this point, I'm convinced we're actually going to be successful in this.
predictions.prediction: Vivek Ramaswamy predicts that his 2024 presidential campaign will be successful, i.e., that he will ultimately win the race for U.S. president (through securing the Republican nomination and then the general election).

predictions.quote: We planned to be in third by November December, ahead of the Iowa caucuses, ahead of New Hampshire. Overperform expectations in both of those use the momentum to then win the race. That was broadly the strategy... I think we're just now on a different curve where, you know, we might be in second place by then and by a smaller margin than people expected.
predictions.prediction: Vivek Ramaswamy predicts that by November–December 2023, before the Iowa caucuses and New Hampshire primary, he will be polling in at least 3rd place nationally in the Republican primary field, potentially 2nd place with a smaller gap to the frontrunner than expected, and that he will overperform expectations in both Iowa and New Hampshire and then use that momentum to go on to win the 2024 Republican presidential nomination.

predictions.quote: I want to be elected the next president, and I think I will be
predictions.prediction: Vivek Ramaswamy predicts that he will be elected President of the United States in the 2024 election cycle.

predictions.quote: I think right now it looks like we're on track to have a Biden-trump rematch. And right now, Biden probably looks like he's going to win, barring a recession happening or the Ukrainian side collapsing in the war or the January 6th indictment.
predictions.prediction: As of July 21, 2023, the 2024 U.S. presidential election will most likely be a Joe Biden vs. Donald Trump rematch, and Joe Biden is more likely than Trump to win the general election, unless one of three conditions occurs before the election: (1) the U.S. falls into a recession, or (2) the Ukrainian side collapses in the Russia–Ukraine war, or (3) a January 6th–related indictment significantly harms Biden’s prospects.

predictions.quote: Spain looks like it's about to tip right.
predictions.prediction: In the near-term (upcoming national election cycle as of July 2023), Spain’s government will shift to the political right (i.e., right-leaning parties will gain power or form the governing coalition).
